title: Just B
meta_description: Find the perfect Seacrest Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘Just B’ a luxury 7-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom home. This home offers a Private Pickleball Court, Pool/Spa, Media & Game Room, & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Brand New Coastal Estate with Gulf Views - Private Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Private Gated Beach Access - Pickleball Court, Media Room, Fitness Room, Shuffleboard - RV Parking - 6 seater Golf Cart and 8 adult Bikes - Elevator Experience a truly exceptional stay along Scenic 30A at Just B, a remarkable private estate crafted for large gatherings, milestone vacations, and elevated coastal escapes. Situated on a generous homesite in Seacrest Beach, this newly built residence offers over 10,000 square feet of beautifully designed living space with an unmatched collection of upscale amenities. From the moment you arrive, the home feels like its own secluded resort. Spend your days lounging beside the expansive private pool and spa, enjoying a match on the regulation-size pickleball court, or keeping up with your routine in the home fitness room. When it’s time to unwind, the third floor offers an incredible entertainment level complete with a bar, media lounge, game space, and sweeping Gulf views that create the perfect backdrop for evenings with family and friends. The estate includes both a grand main residence and an oversized carriage house, giving guests plenty of room to spread out while still enjoying time together. Each bedroom is designed with comfort and privacy in mind, featuring its own ensuite bath and polished, high-end finishes. Located just a short stroll from the beach and moments from the shops, dining, and charm of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, Just B offers a rare combination of privacy, location, and resort-style living, making it an unforgettable destination for your next 30A getaway. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - Office with Sleeper Sofa w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom Second Floor - King Bedroom w/ Two Twin Sleepers w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Bunkroom, 6 XL Twin Beds w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo Third Floor - Full Bathroom, Shower Only - Bonus Sleeping Space w/ Twin Bed X2 Carriage House - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo - Sleeper Sofa
